gold.question: Along the process flow path from P-2-1 to E-38-1, which item has the lowest maximum allowable pressure according to its datasheet? Give the value for every item on the path that has a datasheet.

BV-19-1: pressure class ANSI B16.5 Class 300 (option 300) or ANSI B16.5 Class 150 (option 150), i.e. Class 150 is the lowest. CHV-19-1: pressure ratings vary by end connection, ranging from 254 bar (3700 psig, Male VCR fitting 3/4 in., 100°F) up to 6000 psig (413 bar), plus 260 bar (3770 psig) for the ECE R110 option and 344 bar (5000 psig) for the sour-gas option. CHV-19-2: the same range, with the lowest value 254 bar (3700 psig, Male VCR fitting 3/4 in., 100°F). The lowest maximum allowable pressure on the path is therefore the CHV valve in the Male VCR 3/4 in. configuration at 254 bar (3700 psig), unless the plant's BV-19-1 is built to the Class 150 option, which would be the weakest item by class.
